improvements.rationale: Search engines and social platforms use meta descriptions and OG tags to generate previews. A clear, benefit-focused meta description improves click-through rates from Google results. Properly formatted OG tags ensure LinkedIn, Twitter, and Facebook display a professional preview with correct title, description, and image when the link is shared—critical for credibility with business professionals.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Meet Gideon — get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support for your business operations. Try 3 free searches today."
improvements.rationale: This headline immediately communicates what Gideon is (AI assistant) and who it's for (trade and business professionals). The subheading reinforces key value props (instant answers, voice chat, professional support) while creating a clear, low-friction call to action with the free trial offer. The copy is direct, builds trust without overpromising, and aligns with the confident, professional tone.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to become a Gideon member. Membership starts at just US$2 per day, giving you unlimited access to your personal AI trade and business assistant—including voice chat and your own secure workspace. Choose annual billing and save 30 percent.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in the conversion funnel: the transition from free trial to paid membership. It reassures visitors that the paywall is transparent, reinforces value (unlimited access, voice chat, workspace), and highlights the annual savings incentive—all of which reduce hesitation and encourage sign-up.
